title: Embodied Neuro-symbolic AI: Making Robot Behavior Auditable, Safe, and Scalable
description:
arXiv:2611.31488v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) end-to-end systems have driven major progress in robot learning, yet they still face persistent barriers to dependable real-world deployment. In practice, these models often exhibit brittle generalization under distribution shift (i.e., novel objects, layouts, lighting, or contact conditions), limited physical and causal reasoning, and inconsistent fine-grained motor control.
